title: Sphere-inside-a-cube near miss at Oceana
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Sphere-inside-a-cube near miss at Oceana, about c. 2014-2015 at Naval Air Station Oceana, Virginia, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: the object almost hit the the pilot and it was this uh spear inside a cube
and that's when one of those weird cubinous sphere UAPs split the section.
tellings.difference: Puts it during the Roosevelt carrier training exercise with VFA-11 off the East Coast rather than at Oceana, and says the object split the section.
tellings.link_reason: Both describe the Graves-sourced incident in which a sphere-inside-a-cube UAP passed between, or nearly hit, a section of Navy F-18s in 2014-2015.

as_told.title: UAP splits a section of F-18s during the carrier training exercise
as_told.place_text: Off the US East Coast, VFA-11 from USS Theodore Roosevelt

plain: This story is about a near collision between a Navy fighter jet and a strange object around 2014 or 2015, off the US East Coast. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, relays what a Navy pilot named Ryan Graves has described: an object that almost hit a pilot and looked like a sphere inside a cube. Michels places it around Naval Air Station Oceana, a Navy airbase in Virginia. A retired Navy admiral, Tim Gallaudet, tells it as happening during a training exercise with the aircraft carrier Roosevelt and a fighter squadron called VFA-11, and says the cube-and-sphere object flew right between two jets flying together. If true, it would mean unknown objects were putting military pilots in danger.
